rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=200, val_chunk=5, train_n=400, epochs=20, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, tv_K=10, tv_step_init=0.003, tv_lambda_init=1.0, tv_share_steps=False, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-15 (breast_ct). STEP x active-lambda interaction. With lambda now ACTIVE (the productive lever), re-test a larger step to see if ANY data-consistency update survives alongside the TV denoising. Earlier step probes (iters 2/3) were at DEAD lambda=1e-3 where step->0; now lambda=1.0 carries denoising and a larger step MIGHT add data-consistency instead of collapsing. ONE KNOB vs iter-12 (K=10, lambda=1.0, epochs=20, step=1e-3, hr=0.1495): tv_step_init 1e-3->3e-3. HYPOTHESIS: at 3e-3 the per-iter data-gradient update is large enough to refine data-consistency (not just TV-smooth) so hr rises above 0.1495; iter-1 showed 1e-2 diverges, so 3e-3 is the untested middle. FALSIFIER: if step still collapses to ~0 (hr~0.15) OR diverges (hr drops), data-consistency is structurally unavailable and TV-denoising ~0.15 is the ceiling. BUDGET: iter-12 epochs=20 under wall.
